summary: Peter Shaw contacted HomeNet to report an incorrect billing charge for his account due to him being subscribed to the premium plan when he initially signed up for the basic plan. The agent immediately switched his account back to the basic plan and issued a refund of three months’ worth of overcharged fees. Peter received confirmation via email detailing this change, and no further assistance was required from the agent.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly identified the customer’s name (Peter Shaw) and address.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration with the billing discrepancy, stating their apology.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a professional tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions or defensive language.

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s concern about being overcharged in simple terms.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Peter Shaw's name and account details.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: – The agent asked clarifying questions like "So it's a mistake on your end?" to understand the root cause of the issue.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: The agent clearly explained the refund process, including timelines for processing.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent immediately offered a solution (refunding the overcharged amount).

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: – The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue and didn’t deflect blame.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Peter Shaw's explanation without interrupting or offering unsolicited advice.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: The agent confirmed that the refund was processed successfully.

suggestions: The client was billed for a premium plan when they signed up for the basic one.
They’ve been refunded three months of overage charges.
Confirm the account details are correct to avoid future issues.
Offer further assistance with any questions about the new plan.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason

response_times.client_text: I'm being billed for the premium plan but I only signed up for the basic one.
response_times.agent_text: I'm sorry about the confusion, let me verify and get to the bottom of it.
Could you confirm your name and the address on the account?
Thank you, Peter. Let me compare your order to what's being billed.
You're right. Your original order was the basic plan, but the account shows premium.

response_times.client_text: So it's a mistake on your end.
response_times.agent_text: It is, and I apologise. I'll switch you back to basic effective immediately.
I'll refund the difference for every month you were overcharged.
Three months, and I've calculated the total. The refund will process in 3 to 5 business days.
You'll get a confirmation email with the plan change and refund. Anything else I can help with?
Thank you, Peter, have a great day.
